title: build probes: an empty dashboard card, a roll-up that never computed, and a flow step naming a connector action that does not resolve
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-18, verbatim: 「你要评估，云端哪些要迁移到开源项目，相关卡片要么关闭要么等待」, after 「开源项目能做的尽量在开源项目做，云端等开源项目完全优化好再开工」. Source of the inventory: a reading of the hosted tree at cloud main `0aabf9aa` against this repository's main `b1eb500d`, 2026-11-18. The open repository's agents cannot read the hosted tree, so what each item does is written here.

## Why

A build can be valid, published and still open as an empty page: a card whose query returns nothing, a total that reads zero because its roll-up never ran, a flow step pointing at a connector action the environment does not have. Only the hosted build check looks for these today.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts`). Reader: an author, or an AI client, right after a build.

## Evidence

- The open build probes report `seed_not_applied`, `widget_query_failed`, `widget_not_probed` and `view_read_failed`. They do not report a widget whose query succeeds and returns nothing, a roll-up with no computed value, a seed reference that resolves to no row, or an unresolved connector action.

## Scope

- Four probes beside the existing ones, as warnings: the widget's real query returned no rows or only zeros; a summary field is unset on every parent that has children; a seed row's reference matches no row; a `connector_action` step names a connector or an action the runtime does not have.
- Each says which artefact and what a user will see.

## Done when

- A build with each of the four conditions reports it, and the draft door's verdict (#34766) carries the same findings.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34766, #34779, #34780.
